title: Destination C1&C2 · Review 7 · B · Review 7: key word transformation · tr.120

parts.name: B · Review 7: key word transformation · tr.120
parts.instructions: Complete the second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence, using the word given. Do not change the word given. You must use between three and eight words, including the word given.

items.stem:
You're asking for trouble by arguing with the boss so aggressively like that. [ICE]
You're ____ by arguing with the boss so aggressively like that.
items.explanation_vi: 'Skate on thin ice' là làm điều mạo hiểm.
items.review_reason: Viết lại câu: có thể có cách đúng khác ngoài đáp án sách.
